title: Hardship Desk Schedule: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Arrears Share by Payment Record
content:
**Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract — arrears share for a payment taken toward an extension.**

**Schedule.** The arrears share is replaced by 70 percent when the contract shows at least 18 installments satisfied and no late charge in the last 12 calendar months, and by 85 percent when the contract shows at least 12 installments satisfied and no more than 2 late charges in the last 12 calendar months, where the first condition is not met; in every other case the arrears share is not replaced.

| Installments satisfied | Late charges on the contract, last 12 calendar months | Arrears share |
|---|---|---|
| 18 or more | none | replaced by 70 percent |
| 18 or more | one or two | replaced by 85 percent |
| 12 to 17 | none, one or two | replaced by 85 percent |
| 12 or more | three or more | not replaced |
| fewer than 12 | any | not replaced |

**Records and counting.** The installments satisfied are the count shown on the contract record; the late charges are the late charge entries on the contract's ledger. Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are the difference in month numbers, less one when the later date's day number is smaller than the earlier date's, with no month-end adjustment; an entry lies in the last N calendar months when its date is not after today and fewer than N whole months run from its date to today, which is the same as being dated after the same day number N months before today.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- 18 satisfied, no late charge: 70 percent; 18 satisfied, one late charge: 85 percent.
- 12 satisfied, exactly 2 late charges: 85 percent; 12 satisfied, 3 late charges: not replaced.
- 11 satisfied, no late charge: not replaced.
